# Last Actor run's log

The API endpoint described in this section is convenience endpoint that provides access to last Actor run's log.

Same as of functionality described in: [Logs](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/logs.md)

<!-- -->

## [Get last Actor run's log](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-log-get.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/runs/last/log](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-log-get.md)
